subject: Starter MAP + slide seed for Railroad.io pilot
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Brooks <lauren@railroad-io.com>, Samir Patel <samir@railroad-io.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Starter MAP + slide seed for Railroad.io pilot

Hi Lauren / Samir —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Per our conversation I pulled together a lightweight MAP (mutual action plan) and a short slide seed to help us scope a 30-day pilot and define acceptance gates. The two files attached are intentionally skinny — template + suggested milestones so we can iterate quickly:

- Railroad_MAP_Template_v0.1.gdoc (editable Google Doc) — MAP sections: stakeholders, success metrics, technical checks, security blockers, timeline/gates.
- Railroad_MAP_30d-slate.gslides — one-slide summary and suggested week-by-week checkpoints.
- pilot-scope-questions.xlsx — quick tech checklist (networking, sample data, auth).

High-level suggestion: 30-day pilot with these gates:
1) Week 1: env & credentials + smoke run (tech readiness)
2) Week 2: integration + latency/cost baseline
3) Week 3: quality checks + sample evals
4) Week 4: acceptance + rollout plan

Open questions for you so we can finalize the MAP:
- Who will be our primary technical lead and the security/compliance reviewer on your side?
- Are there any non-negotiable compliance requirements (data residency, logging retention) we should reflect in the timeline?
- Preferred kickoff window next week (we listed two slots in the doc).

If you’re ok I’ll set the doc to co-edit and propose a short kickoff (30–40m) to align stakeholders and lock the week-1 checklist.

Thanks — looking forward to iterating.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
stephanie@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Thanks for the clear starter pack. A couple quick things from our side:

2) Stakeholders: I will be the product sponsor, Samir is our infra lead (copied), and I’ll pull in Mira Kline (security) once we lock the plan.
3) Kickoff: Tue 23 Jun or Wed 24 Jun morning PT works for us — prefer Tue if possible.

I left a few inline comments in the MAP doc about the acceptance criteria for quality (thresholds for intent/NRR). I’ll also add Mira to the doc once I have her OK to share.

Lauren — thanks, and great callout on EU residency. Short answers and next steps below: 

- Residency: we can run the pilot in our eu-central region (data stays in EU for processing). I flagged the MAP with a "data residency" line item in Week 0/1 and attached a short security note.
- Security reviewer: happy to wait for Mira. In the meantime Jonas added a short table in the doc listing the audit artifacts we can provide (SOC2 scope, retention config, access logs).
- Kickoff: Tue 23 Jun 11:00 AM PT / 2:00 PM ET works for our delivery team. I will send a calendar invite once you confirm.

I also made two small edits to the MAP: tightened the acceptance matrix (sample pass/fail thresholds) and added a fallback SLA path (if latency targets unmet, switch to a lower-cost quantized variant for the pilot). See "Railroad_MAP_Template_v0.1.gdoc" (comments resolved where possible).

Next steps:
- Lauren to confirm Mira + Samir availability for the Tue 23 Jun kickoff.
- We will co-edit the week-1 tech checklist and finalize the sample dataset scope before the meeting.

If you want me to include a short security appendix in the slides I can add one pager that maps artifacts to your requirements.

Thanks — I’ll hold the slot tentatively and send the invite after your confirmation.

Best,
Stephanie
